content.short: Pixels is a popular open-world Web3 farming and exploration MMORPG built natively on the Ronin network.
content.description:
Pixels is a leading Web3-native social MMORPG that invites players to build, gather, and explore a vast, pixelated virtual world. Originally launched on Polygon, the game migrated to the Ronin Network to leverage its high throughput and player-centric gaming infrastructure. Participants can own NFT-based land plots, craft valuable items, and collaborate with a global community of players to earn on-chain rewards while building their digital legacy.

The ecosystem is powered by the $PIXEL token, which facilitates in-game transactions, governance, and premium features. Pixels emphasizes interoperability and player sovereignty, allowing users to carry their digital assets and identity across a growing virtual universe. Through its engaging mechanics and transparent blockchain-based ownership, Pixels has become a cornerstone of the modern gaming landscape, empowering millions of users to participate in a vibrant and meritocratic virtual economy.
content.meta: Pixels is a gamified farming and exploration MMORPG on Ronin featuring NFT land ownership and on-chain rewards.
